senses.definition: Aboard a ship or other conveyance, as part of the cargo.
examples: The company will not be responsible for the loss of shipped goods in transit.

senses.definition: on board a ship, as a passenger

quotes.text: I hope, the king is not yet shipped for Ireland

senses.definition: Furnished with a ship or ships.
